fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: When the field is set to true or unset in Terraform state, a terraform apply or terraform destroy that would delete the instance will fail.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The human-readable display name of the Bigtable instance.

fields.label: Force Destroy
fields.help: When deleting a BigTable instance, this boolean option will delete all backups within the instance.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name (also called Instance Id in the Cloud Console) of the Cloud Bigtable instance.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.

fields.label: Cluster
Cluster ID
fields.help: The ID of the Cloud Bigtable cluster.

fields.label: KMS Key Name
fields.help: Describes the Cloud KMS encryption key that will be used to protect the destination Bigtable cluster.

fields.label: Node Scaling Factor
fields.help: The node scaling factor of this cluster.

fields.label: Num Nodes
fields.help: The number of nodes in the cluster.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: The zone to create the Cloud Bigtable cluster in.

fields.label: Cpu Target
fields.help: The target CPU utilization for autoscaling.

fields.label: Max Nodes
fields.help: The maximum number of nodes for autoscaling.

fields.label: Min Nodes
fields.help: The minimum number of nodes for autoscaling.

fields.label: Storage Target
fields.help: The target storage utilization for autoscaling, in GB, for each node in a cluster.
A block of cluster configuration options.
